national_news.title: 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting Held in New Delhi
bullets: Union Minister Bhupender Yadav addressed the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi, emphasizing people-centric environmental action.
India's BRICS chairship vision is guided by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, focusing on the Global South under the theme 'Building Resilience and Innovation for Cooperation and Sustainability'.
The meeting concluded with the adoption of a Joint Ministerial Statement reaffirming commitments to the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, UNFCCC, and the Paris Agreement.

national_news.title: Government Approves Incentive Scheme for Domestic PNG Connections
bullets: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas approved an Incentive Scheme for Promotion of Domestic PNG Connections to fast-track active piped cooking gas connections.
Eligible City Gas Distribution (CGD) entities will receive an additional 200 Standard Cubic Meters of lower-priced domestic gas for every incremental billed connection.
The scheme aims to expand the Piped Natural Gas network, lower gas-sourcing costs, and provide households a safer alternative to LPG and traditional fuels.

national_news.title: Indian Shuttlers Advance at BWF Badminton World Championships
bullets: Lakshya Sen advanced to the men's singles second round at the BWF Badminton World Championships after defeating Austria's Collins Filimon.
Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand advanced to the women's doubles pre-quarterfinals.
Unnati Hooda also advanced to the women's singles second round by defeating Myanmar's Thet Htar Thuzar.

national_news.title: Rishabh Pant Becomes Fastest to Hit 100 Sixes in Test Cricket
bullets: Rishabh Pant became the first Indian and only the fourth player globally to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket.
He achieved the milestone in just his 51st Test match during the first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle.
India set Sri Lanka a target of 372 runs in the match.

national_news.title: Overview of the News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio
bullets: The News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio operates under the motto “Bahujan Hitaya, Bahujan Sukhaya”, broadcasting 24x7 in major languages and dialects.
The first news bulletin in India was broadcasted on July 23, 1927, from the Bombay Station under the Indian Broadcasting Company, which later became All India Radio on June 8, 1936.
NSD currently produces 607 daily news bulletins totaling 3,150 minutes across 92 languages and dialects, supported by correspondents nationwide and international bureaus.

national_news.title: Guidelines and Application Circulars for Akashwani Annual Awards
bullets: Akashwani released guidelines and application forms for its prestigious annual awards, including the K. L. Sharma Award for Best Correspondent and the Best PTC Award.
The awards recognize exceptional contributions by journalists, newsreaders, and correspondents associated with the News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio.
Categories include honors for best news reading, reporting, and regional news broadcasting excellence.

national_news.title: PIB Dehradun Organises 'Vartalaap' Media Workshop in Chamoli
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB), Dehradun, organized a regional media workshop titled 'Vartalaap' in Gopeshwar, Chamoli on August 20.
The workshop focuses on communicating Central Government welfare schemes, women/youth empowerment, farmer welfare, healthcare, GI tags, and One District One Product (ODOP).
Targeted at print, electronic, and digital media professionals in rural and border areas to ensure accurate grassroot dissemination of public service initiatives.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Proposes Youth-Focused Banking Campaign
bullets: The Department of Financial Services (DFS) organized the two-day PSB Confluence 2026, concluding with a focus on agriculture, priority sector lending, and credit card business.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, for youth above 16 years to enhance formal financial inclusion via the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
Emphasized granular monitoring of Priority Sector Lending (PSL) targets and developing digital portals for youth banking and skilling services.

national_news.title: 97th Annual General Meeting of ICAR Society Emphasizes Integrated Farming
bullets: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan chaired the 97th AGM of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) Society at NASC, New Delhi.
Stressed integrated farming systems, balanced fertilizer use, and improved soil health to diversify incomes of small and marginal farmers.
Called for a demand-driven research ecosystem and strong ICAR-industry partnerships to align agricultural production with global standards.

national_news.title: Ministries Launch 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' Roadmap for Agriculture and Rural Development
bullets: A commitment program was organized in New Delhi to operationalize 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Independence Day.
Administered a collective pledge to officials, scientists, FPOs, and Lakhpati Didis to boost quality, safety, and global market compliance for Indian agriculture.
Focuses on connecting Indian farm produce (spices, fruits, traditional foods) directly to international export markets.

national_news.title: India's Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) Drive Record Merchandise and Services Exports
bullets: India's combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026, combined exports rose by 11.37% to an estimated US$ 232.73 billion, supported by expanding Free Trade Agreements (FTAs).
The India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), enacted on May 1, 2022, emerged as India's largest individual FTA export market with US$ 37,359.11 million in FY 2025-26.

national_news.title: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports Announces National Sports Awards 2025
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports announced the National Sports Awards 2025 based on recommendations of a Selection Committee chaired by former Supreme Court Judge Justice (Retd.) Arun Kumar Mishra.

Arjuna Awards 2025 were conferred on prominent sportspersons including Tejaswin Shankar (Athletics), Vidit Santosh Gujarathi (Chess), Lalremsiami (Hockey), and Ekta Bhyan (Para athletics) among others.
Army Paralympic Node, Pune was awarded the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar 2025 for sports promotion and development.

bihar_news.title: India's Carbon Credit Programmes and Smallholder Farmers in Bihar
bullets: Focuses on the Indian Carbon Market and Green Credit Programme by the Government of India.
Highlights that India accounts for about 4.1 percent of the global voluntary carbon market, while smallholders constitute over 80 percent of farmers.
A study involving smallholder farmers in Bihar shows that upfront financial support and technical training are crucial for successful voluntary carbon credit participation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Joins Centre's Direct Pulse Procurement Network
bullets: In a first, Bihar has joined the Centre's direct pulse procurement network allowing central agencies to procure masoor directly from farmers.
Central agencies NCCF and Nafed have procured around 3,000 tonnes of masoor against a target of 32,000 tonnes at an MSP of ₹7,000 per quintal.
Bihar produces nearly 400,000 tonnes of pulses annually and accounts for around 448,000 hectares under pulse cultivation.

bihar_news.title: Darbhanga Ranks Second in Bihar in Sugarcane IDs
bullets: Darbhanga has emerged as Bihar’s second-highest district with 24,215 farmers obtaining Sugarcane IDs under the sugarcane expansion campaign.
West Champaran ranks first in Bihar in the number of farmers who have obtained Sugarcane IDs.
The Sugarcane ID connects farmers with government schemes, technical support, and cultivator incentives.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Resume Mining Operations After October 15, Announces CM Samrat Choudhary
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the auction of critical and strategic mineral blocks and the NMEDT workshop organized by the Ministry of Coal and Mines in Patna.
The state government announced that over 30 of the 44 surveyed coal blocks will be allocated before September 30, with mining operations scheduled to begin after October 15.
Key mineral reserves highlighted include limestone in Rohtas, mineral belts in Aurangabad, magnets in Jehanabad and Jamui, and significant resources in Gaya, Banka, and Bhagalpur.

bihar_news.title: Bihar's Critical Mineral Potential Offers New Investment Opportunities
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary highlighted the state's critical mineral potential during an event on the auction of mineral blocks in Patna.
The state is focusing on innovation and attracting investments by leveraging its untapped strategic mineral reserves.
The move is expected to boost industrial growth and create new economic avenues within the state.

bihar_news.title: Patna Metro Receives INR 628.32 Crore Funding Under Centre's Capital Investment Scheme
bullets: Patna Metro has been granted INR 628.32 crore under the Central Government's capital investment scheme.
The additional financial backing aims to accelerate ongoing construction work across the metro's corridors.
The funding highlights the Centre's support for enhancing urban transport infrastructure in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Allocate Over 30 Mineral Blocks by September to Boost Mining Sector
bullets: Bihar plans to allocate more than 30 mineral and coal blocks by the end of September to boost the state's mining sector.
The initiative addresses the state's growing infrastructure needs by ensuring the utilization of local stone and minerals.
The systematic allocation of blocks is part of broader efforts to drive industrialization and investment in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar initiates site survey for 129 EV charging stations across 23 districts
bullets: Site surveys have begun for setting up 129 electric vehicle (EV) charging stations across 23 districts in Bihar.
The initiative aims to develop a robust EV charging infrastructure to promote electric mobility in the state.
The project prioritizes expanding clean energy transport networks outside major urban centers as well.
